messages:
sara (People Ops): Heads up: retirement plan vendor is switching to Meridian on May 3. How will that affect rollovers, conversions, and distributions?
ben (Payroll): FYI payroll cutoff for elective deferrals is Apr 28 23:59 PT. Any mapping changes after that might not apply until the following payroll cycle. We need to confirm employee ID mappings with the new vendor.
nate (Benefits Ops): Vendor advised a maintenance window May 3	3 to May 5 with limited portal access and paused account updates. Contributions should still post from payroll but allocation updates might be queued. Vendor link (internal): https://vendor.example.com/migration
emma (People Ops): If an employee requests an incoming rollover Apr 30, will the transfer be accepted or will it get delayed? Also wondering about in-plan Roth conversions during the blackout.
ben (Payroll): Incoming rollovers initiated with the current provider by Apr 30 should be accepted, but final posting may be delayed until after the maintenance. In-plan Roth conversions require vendor processing				and are likely paused. Recommend employees hold off on conversions until May 6.
jamal (Legal): We need to capture initiation timestamps and vendor completion timestamps for audit/compliance. Also prepare a short employee notice explaining expected delays and support contacts.
sara (People Ops): Draft outline of notice: 1) payroll deferral cutoff, 2) rollover initiation cutoff, 3) in-plan Roth conversions paused during migration, 4) how to request exceptions. I'll draft and post for review shortly.
emma (People Ops): Please include a brief manager-facing blurb + an FAQ covering loans, beneficiary changes, retirees, and HSA/FSA impact.
ben (Payroll): Sample content we can include in the notice:

``
Payroll cutoff: Apr 28 23:59 PT
Submit rollover requests to current provider by Apr 30
In-plan Roth conversions paused May 3			through May 5; please wait until May 6 to convert
For migration exceptions: benefits@redwood.com (subject: Migration Exception)
``

sara (People Ops): Also flag any accounts with active distributions (retiree pensions) for manual handling. @jamal can you confirm whether distributions/benefit payments continue?
jamal (Legal): I'll confirm. Also confirming whether outstanding loan repayments will continue to amortize or if they'll queue. Waiting on vendor clarification.
vendorbot (Benefits Vendor): Automated: migration maintenance window 2026-05-03T02:00Z to 2026-05-05T08:00Z. Support available; some account updates may be queued.
emma (People Ops): Quick check on HSA/FSA: HSA contributions flow through payroll and are not impacted; FSA elections are separate. Can we state that in the FAQ?
sara (People Ops): Confirmed. HSA contributions unaffected; FSA admin unaffected. Draft notice ready, will share in ~25 minutes for review.
ben (Payroll): Logistics note: catch-up contributions (age 50+) are processed as deferrals. Ensure payroll maps the new plan code properly. We'll run a dry-run payroll file on Apr 25 to verify mapping.
emma (People Ops): I'll create an Asana task for the dry-run and tag payroll + benefits to confirm by Apr 27.
sara (People Ops): Great. I'll post the employee notice at 8:00 AM PT tomorrow and tag payroll. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround!
